t: Pipulate's Client-Side Wisdom: Polishing Cross-Platform AI and the Yellow Brick Road to AIE
s: This article details Pipulate's transition from foundational development to a sophisticated polish phase, highlighting elegant client-side solutions for cross-platform AI integration, local LLMs on diverse hardware, and the evolving philosophy of AI-assisted development (AIE).
sub: Client-side intelligence for platform-aware messaging and onboarding.
Cross-platform development challenges (NixOS, macOS, WSL) and solutions (chromedriver, Ollama memory, afplay).
Local LLM deployment (Gemma3) on low-resource hardware via WSL.
AI-assisted development (AIE) workflow: context, tutor, regression.
The 'Yellow Brick Road' metaphor for user onboarding and AI integration.
